query:
SELECT lr.employee_id, lr.start_date, lr.end_date
           FROM leave_requests lr
           JOIN employees e ON lr.employee_id = e.id
           WHERE e.workspace_id = $1
             AND lr.employee_id = ANY($2)
             AND lr.status IN ('approved', 'pre_approved')
             AND lr.start_date <= $4
             AND lr.end_date >= $3
